title: Senior Flutter Developer
description:
Job Description – Senior Flutter Developer

**Position:** Senior Flutter Developer  
**Location:** Malad, Mumbai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 2–4 Years  
**Department:** Technology / Development  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong **Senior Flutter Developer** to join our technology team in **Malad, Mumbai**.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on expertise in **Flutter and Dart**, with proven experience in architecting, developing, optimizing, and maintaining **high\-performing, scalable mobile applications** capable of handling high traffic, large datasets, and complex business requirements.

This role requires someone who goes beyond application development and takes ownership of **application architecture, performance, security, coding standards, version control, scalability, compliance awareness, automation, and continuous technical improvement**.

The candidate will work closely with internal development, UI/UX, backend, QA, product, and management teams to deliver robust and production\-ready applications for Android and iOS.

Key Responsibilities1\. Flutter \& Mobile Application Development

* Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality cross\-platform applications using **Flutter and Dart**.
* Build applications that are **scalable, secure, reliable, and optimized for high traffic and heavy data usage**.
* Develop reusable, modular, and maintainable components.
* Implement complex business logic while maintaining clean and efficient architecture.
* Work closely with backend developers for seamless API integration and data handling.
* Integrate third\-party APIs, SDKs, payment gateways, analytics, notifications, and other external services.
* Ensure applications perform consistently across different devices, screen sizes, and operating\-system versions.

2\. Application Architecture \& Scalability

* Design and implement **scalable mobile application architecture** suitable for large user bases and high\-volume transactions.
* Select appropriate architectural patterns and state\-management approaches based on project requirements.
* Design applications capable of efficiently handling **large datasets, high API traffic, concurrent users, and complex workflows**.
* Identify potential scalability and performance bottlenecks at the architecture and development stages.
* Ensure appropriate separation of presentation, business logic, data, and service layers.
* Develop reusable architecture and technical frameworks that can be leveraged across multiple applications.

3\. Performance \& High\-Traffic Applications

* Optimize applications for **speed, responsiveness, memory usage, battery consumption, and overall stability**.
* Work on applications handling **high traffic and large volumes of data**.
* Optimize API calls, database interactions, caching, pagination, lazy loading, background processing, and data rendering.
* Identify and resolve application crashes, ANRs, memory leaks, UI jank, slow screen rendering, and performance bottlenecks.
* Conduct profiling and performance analysis using appropriate Flutter and platform\-level tools.
* Ensure applications remain responsive and stable under heavy workloads.

4\. UI/UX \& Micro\-Interactions

* Convert UI/UX designs into highly polished, responsive, and production\-ready interfaces.
* Implement **micro\-animations, transitions, gestures, interactive elements, and smooth screen navigation** to enhance the user experience.
* Maintain consistency in typography, spacing, layouts, components, and design systems.
* Work closely with UI/UX designers to improve usability, accessibility, responsiveness, and overall application experience.
* Ensure animations are performance\-efficient and do not negatively impact application performance.

5\. Security \& Vulnerability Awareness

* Follow secure coding practices throughout the application development lifecycle.
* Identify and address **security vulnerabilities, insecure API usage, data exposure, authentication issues, and dependency risks**.
* Ensure sensitive information such as credentials, tokens, and user data is handled securely.
* Keep Flutter, Dart, third\-party packages, SDKs, and dependencies updated to address known security vulnerabilities.
* Participate in security reviews and remediation of vulnerabilities identified through internal or external security assessments.
* Maintain awareness of mobile application security standards and emerging security threats.

6\. Software Version Control \& Development Practices

* Maintain disciplined use of **Git and version\-control systems** such as GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket.
* Follow proper branching, merging, pull\-request, tagging, release, and rollback strategies.
* Maintain clean and meaningful commit history.
* Conduct and participate in peer **code reviews**.
* Ensure code changes are properly documented and traceable.
* Establish and enforce development standards across projects and teams.

7\. Coding Standards \& Code Quality

* Write **clean, efficient, readable, maintainable, and reusable code**.
* Follow established Flutter/Dart coding standards and best practices.
* Establish and maintain coding guidelines, naming conventions, project structures, documentation standards, and review processes.
* Refactor legacy or inefficient code where required.
* Reduce technical debt and proactively identify areas requiring architectural or code\-level improvement.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level developers on coding practices, architecture, debugging, and performance optimization.

8\. Compliance, Upgrades \& Technology Awareness

* Work with internal technical teams to ensure applications remain aligned with required **platform, technology, security, and compliance standards**.
* Maintain awareness of changes and upgrade requirements related to:
* Flutter and Dart versions
* Android and iOS versions
* Google Play Store and Apple App Store requirements
* Third\-party SDKs and APIs
* Security vulnerabilities and patches
* Data and application\-security requirements
* Plan and execute technology upgrades without compromising application stability.
* Coordinate with internal teams for vulnerability remediation, compliance requirements, technology upgrades, and release readiness.
* Proactively assess the impact of technology changes before implementation.

9\. AI \& Automation

* Explore and implement **AI\-assisted development and automation tools** to improve development productivity and software quality.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive development, testing, documentation, monitoring, deployment, and support activities.
* Leverage AI tools responsibly for code generation, code review, debugging, testing, documentation, and development acceleration.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their practical application within mobile application development.
* Contribute ideas for improving development workflows through automation.

10\. Testing, Release \& Production Support

* Develop applications with strong emphasis on quality and production stability.
* Write and maintain appropriate **unit, widget, integration, and automated tests**.
* Work closely with QA teams to resolve defects and improve application quality.
* Support application deployment and release processes for **Google Play Store and Apple App Store**.
* Monitor production issues and provide timely technical resolution.
* Participate in root\-cause analysis and implement preventive measures for recurring issues.
* Support production releases, hotfixes, version upgrades, and application maintenance.

Required Technical Skills

* **4–7 years of professional software development experience**, with strong hands\-on experience in Flutter.
* Advanced knowledge of **Flutter and Dart**.
* Strong understanding of mobile application architecture and design patterns.
* Experience building **large\-scale and high\-performance applications**.
* Experience handling **high traffic, large datasets, complex API integrations, and performance optimization**.
* Strong knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS and asynchronous programming.
* Strong experience with state management such as **Bloc, Riverpod, Provider, GetX**, or equivalent.
* Strong knowledge of **Git and software version\-control practices**.
* Experience with CI/CD and automated build and deployment processes.
* Strong understanding of debugging, profiling, memory management, and performance optimization.
* Experience with Firebase services such as Authentication, Cloud Messaging, Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config, etc.
* Experience integrating third\-party SDKs and APIs.
* Good understanding of application security and vulnerability management.
* Experience with automated testing and quality\-assurance practices.
* Familiarity with Android and iOS application lifecycle and release processes.

Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills

* Experience with native **Android/Kotlin** or **iOS/Swift** development.
* Experience with complex animations and advanced Flutter UI.
* Experience with payment gateway integration.
* Experience with real\-time applications, WebSockets, push notifications, or streaming data.
* Experience with offline\-first applications, local databases, caching, and synchronization.
* Knowledge of CI/CD tools and cloud\-based development environments.
* Experience with application monitoring and crash/performance analytics.
* Understanding of OWASP Mobile Application Security principles.
* Experience working on applications with millions of users or high transaction volumes.
* Exposure to AI\-powered development and automation tools.

Leadership \& Ownership

As a Senior Developer, the candidate will be expected to take **technical ownership** of assigned applications and modules.

Responsibilities will include:

* Independently analyse technical requirements and propose appropriate solutions.
* Take ownership of application architecture and technical implementation.
* Review code and provide constructive technical feedback to other developers.
* Mentor junior developers and help improve overall team capability.
* Identify technical risks and communicate them proactively.
* Participate in technical discussions, estimation, planning, and solution design.
* Take ownership of production issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain technical documentation and architectural knowledge.
* Continuously evaluate opportunities to improve application performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for a candidate who demonstrates:

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent understanding of software engineering principles.
* Strong ownership and accountability for deliverables.
* Ability to work independently on complex technical problems.
* Strong attention to application performance, security, and quality.
* Ability to think beyond immediate requirements and build solutions for future scalability.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* A continuous\-learning mindset with awareness of emerging technologies.
* Ability to mentor team members and contribute to improving engineering practices.

Education

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering**, or a related technical field is preferred.
* Equivalent practical experience and strong technical expertise will also be considered.

Key Success Areas

The successful candidate will be evaluated on their ability to:

**Build → Scale → Secure → Optimize → Automate → Maintain**

* Build robust Flutter applications.
* Design for scalability and high traffic.
* Maintain strong security and compliance awareness.
* Deliver excellent UI/UX and application performance.
* Follow high\-quality coding and version\-control standards.
* Reduce technical debt and improve existing applications.
* Introduce meaningful automation and AI\-assisted development practices.
* Take complete technical ownership of assigned applications.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on **high\-scale and technically challenging mobile applications**.
* Exposure to modern technologies, AI\-assisted development, automation, security, and application optimization.
* Opportunity to work with experienced technology and product teams.
* Professional and collaborative work environment.
* Continuous learning and career\-growth opportunities.
* Opportunity to contribute to technical architecture and engineering standards.
* Full\-time position based at our **Malad, Mumbai office**.

Application Requirements

Interested candidates are requested to share their **updated CV** along with:

* Total years of experience
* Relevant Flutter experience
* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice period
* Current location
* Availability for an interview
* Links to relevant applications/projects, GitHub profile, or portfolio, wherever applicable

title: Android Developer
description:
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 3\.5\+ Years  
**Role:** Android Developer

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Android Developer** with a minimum of **3\.5 years of hands\-on experience in native Android application development**. The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of **Kotlin, Java, Android SDK, Fragments, Android lifecycle, MVVM/MVI, REST APIs, Retrofit, Coroutines, and Dagger/Hilt**.

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining, debugging, and optimizing production\-level Android applications while following clean, scalable, and maintainable coding practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain native Android applications.
* Build scalable and maintainable applications using **Kotlin and Java**.
* Work with **MVVM/MVI, Repository Pattern, Clean Architecture**, and modular application structures.
* Develop Android UI using **Activities, Fragments, XML, RecyclerView, ViewBinding/DataBinding**, and Material Design.
* Handle **Activity and Fragment lifecycle**, configuration changes, navigation, and back\-stack management.
* Integrate REST APIs using **Retrofit and OkHttp**.
* Implement proper API error handling, timeouts, retries, and network\-failure scenarios.
* Use **Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, LiveData, ViewModel, Lifecycle components, and WorkManager**.
* Implement dependency injection using **Dagger/Hilt**, including modules, scopes, and ViewModel injection.
* Work with local data storage using **Room, DataStore, SharedPreferences**, or similar technologies.
* Debug and resolve **crashes, ANRs, memory leaks, performance issues, and production defects**.
* Optimize application performance, startup time, memory usage, and responsiveness.
* Follow Android security, lifecycle, performance, and coding best practices.
* Use Git for branching, merging, pull requests, and conflict resolution.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving overall code quality.
* Understand existing production code and enhance it without impacting existing functionality.

**Required Technical Skills Android**

* Strong hands\-on experience with native Android development.
* Good understanding of **Android SDK, Android Studio, Gradle**, and Android project structure.
* Strong knowledge of **Activity and Fragment lifecycle**.
* Experience with Fragment transactions, Navigation Component, back\-stack handling, and lifecycle\-aware components.
* Understanding of Android permissions, services, broadcast receivers, notifications, and background execution limitations.

**Kotlin \& Java**

* Strong hands\-on experience with **Kotlin**.
* Good working knowledge of **Java**.
* Strong understanding of OOP, collections, null safety, extension functions, data classes, sealed classes, and Kotlin best practices.
* Ability to write clean, readable, reusable, and maintainable code.

**Architecture**

* Strong practical experience with **MVVM**.
* Understanding of **MVI and Clean Architecture** is an advantage.
* Experience with Repository Pattern, separation of concerns, use cases, and modular application design.

**Dependency Injection**

* Hands\-on experience with **Dagger or Hilt**.
* Understanding of modules, dependency injection, scopes, qualifiers, and ViewModel injection.

Jetpack Components

**Hands\-on experience with:**

* ViewModel
* LiveData
* Kotlin Flow
* Lifecycle Components
* Navigation Component
* Room Database
* WorkManager
* Paging Library, if applicable

**Networking**

* Experience integrating REST APIs.
* Strong knowledge of **Retrofit and OkHttp**.
* Experience with interceptors and authentication mechanisms.
* Knowledge of JSON parsing using **Gson, Moshi, or Kotlin Serialization**.
* Ability to handle network failures, timeouts, retries, and slow\-network conditions.

**Git \& Collaboration**

description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.


  
**Your mission**
----------------


**About the Organisation \& Role:**


You will be part of the Consumer Experience Engineering organisation responsible for building fast, intuitive, accessible and premium digital experiences across web and mobile. The organisation owns the web \& mobile platforms, engineering delivery for consumer\-facing journeys, shared design systems, performance, accessibility and AI\-native engineering practices that help product teams deliver consistent, reusable, high\-quality consumer experiences across the globe.


The Senior Software Engineer (Mobile) is responsible for designing, building, optimizing, and supporting scalable consumer\-facing mobile applications while driving engineering excellence, architectural best practices, and operational reliability across iOS and Android platforms.


**What you will do:**


* Design, build and maintain scalable mobile applications using React Native, TypeScript and JavaScript.
* Develop native iOS and Android integrations to deliver seamless consumer experiences.
* Define and implement robust application architecture, state management and API integration patterns.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Design, QA and Engineering teams to deliver high\-quality consumer\-facing solutions.
* Build secure, reliable and high\-performing mobile applications following engineering best practices.
* Develop reusable components, shared libraries and mobile engineering frameworks.
* Implement testing, code quality and automation practices across the development lifecycle.
* Monitor, troubleshoot and optimise application performance, stability and consumer experience.
* Contribute to App Store and Google Play releases, CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, technical mentoring and continuous improvement.
* Shape architecture decisions, produce technical documentation and maintain engineering standards within the team.
* Participate in Agile delivery activities including planning, estimation, refinement and retrospectives.
* Support experimentation, feature flagging and data\-driven product optimisation initiatives.
**Your talent**
---------------


* 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant hands\-on experience building mobile applications.
* Strong hands\-on experience with React Native, TypeScript and modern JavaScript development.
* Solid understanding of iOS and Android platforms, application lifecycle and mobile platform capabilities.
* Experience developing and integrating native iOS and Android modules when required.
* Strong knowledge of mobile architecture patterns, modular design and scalable application development.
* Experience implementing state management solutions and application data flow patterns.
* Experience integrating mobile applications with REST and GraphQL APIs.
* Strong understanding of secure application development, authentication, data protection and consumer privacy practices.
* Experience building reusable components, shared libraries and maintainable mobile architectures.
* Strong experience with unit, integration and end\-to\-end testing, including test automation.
* Experience troubleshooting production issues, analysing crashes, monitoring application health and optimising performance.
* Knowledge of observability, logging, release management and operational support practices.
* Experience conducting code reviews, mentoring engineers and promoting engineering best practices.
* Understanding of accessibility standards, mobile accessibility practices, mobile UX principles and cross\-device compatibility.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication and collaboration skills.
* Experience in Consumer, Retail, eCommerce or DTC products is preferred.
* Experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging and A/B testing is a plus.
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools and practices to improve development quality, delivery efficiency, testing and technical documentation.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
**Our principles**
------------------


PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.


PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.
